name: dotfiles-lsp
description: Wire Claude Code's LSP tool (navigation, hover, symbols, diagnostics after edits) at the devshell's language servers: nu --lsp for *.nu, nixd for *.nix, lua-language-server for *.lua, marksman for *.md, taplo for *.toml. All run through `direnv exec` so they're the flake-pinned binaries Zed and Neovim use.
